title: Oven Baked Saudi Arabian Tomato Flatbread
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dish featuring a flaky flatbread topped with a bitter tomato puree, perfect for midnight cravings. This vegan-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and knead for 5 minutes.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large circle.
Place the dough on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spread the tomato puree over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the olive oil over the tomato puree.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing.
